package.name: g1_description
package.description: Canonical Unitree G1 (23-DOF) robot description for the WiscoHumanoids integration stack. Ported from bipedal_nav/src/g1_description (g1_23dof_rev_1_0 variant) and converted to a xacro file so the ros2_control hardware plugin can be selected at launch time between the MuJoCo sim path and the EtherCAT hardware path. See README.md.
